authorized.description: mochott holds a live authorization for the account.

authorizeUrl.description: Where the account signs in to mochott. After signing in it lands on the mochott dashboard, or with display=popup on a page that closes itself.

display.description: How the client opens authorizeUrl. 'popup': in a popup window; the sign-in then ends on a mochott page that closes itself (the PDS's authorization page sends Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy, so window.opener is gone and nothing is posted back: check again when the client's window regains focus). Omitted or unknown: the sign-in ends on the mochott dashboard.

main.description: A client writing long posts asks this before the first one. Without the authorization, mochott cannot delete an article whose long post was deleted in an app that deletes posts alone; the client should then open authorizeUrl so the account signs in to mochott once.

description: Whether mochott holds the requesting account's authorization (OAuth). Requires auth.
